    - id: roll
      name: Rollups
      computed:
        l:
            rollup: list(links.title)
        "n":
            rollup: count
        s:

        x:
            rollup: other
      source: invoices/
    - id: none
      name: No match
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: nothing
      source: invoices/
    - id: ops
      name: Ops
      filters:
        - key: title
          operator: contains

      filter_group:

              operator: in

      filters:

    - id: open

        - key: status

      name: Paid
      filters:
        - key: status
          value: paid
      filter_group:
        operator: and
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gt
              value: "5"
      source: invoices/
    - id: comp
      name: Computed
      computed:
        label:
            formula: '{title} costs {amount}'
        links:
            rollup: count
      columns:
        - title
        - label
        - links
      source: invoices/
    - id: roll
      name: Rollups
      computed:
        l:
            rollup: list(links.title)
        "n":
            rollup: count
        s:
            rollup: sum(links.amount)
        x:
            rollup: other
      source: invoices/
    - id: none
      name: No match
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: nothing
      source: invoices/
    - id: ops
      name: Ops
      filters:
        - key: title
          operator: contains
          value: O
      filter_group:
        operator: any
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: lt
              value: "6"
            - key: status
              operator: in
              value: paid, closed
      source: invoices/
    - id: dates
      name: Dates
      filters:
        - key: due_date
          operator: on_or_after
          value: "2026-02-01"
      source: invoices/
    - id: noteq
      name: Not equal
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: not_equals
          value: OPEN
      source: invoices/
    - id: empty
      name: Empty op
      filters:
        - key: correspondent
          operator: is_empty
          value: ""
      source: invoices/
    - id: nested
      name: Nested
      filter_group:
        operator: all
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gte
              value: "5.5"
        groups:
            - operator: any
              filters:
                - key: status
                  value: paid
                - key: status
                  value: open
      source: invoices/

---
type: base
title: Open
created: "$TIME"
tags:
    - base
base_id: open
views:
    - id: open
      name: Open
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: open
      columns:
        - title
        - amount
      source: invoices/
    - id: paid
      name: Paid
      filters:
        - key: status
          value: paid
      filter_group:
        operator: and
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gt
              value: "5"
      source: invoices/
    - id: comp
      name: Computed
      computed:
        label:
            formula: '{title} costs {amount}'
        links:
            rollup: count
      columns:
        - title
        - label
        - links
      source: invoices/
    - id: roll
      name: Rollups
      computed:
        l:
            rollup: list(links.title)
        "n":
            rollup: count
        s:
            rollup: sum(links.amount)
        x:
            rollup: other
      source: invoices/
    - id: none
      name: No match
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: nothing
      source: invoices/
    - id: ops
      name: Ops
      filters:
        - key: title
          operator: contains
          value: O
      filter_group:
        operator: any
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: lt
              value: "6"
            - key: status
              operator: in
              value: paid, closed
      source: invoices/
    - id: dates
      name: Dates
      filters:
        - key: due_date
          operator: on_or_after
          value: "2026-02-01"
      source: invoices/
    - id: noteq
      name: Not equal
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: not_equals
          value: OPEN
      source: invoices/
    - id: empty
      name: Empty op
      filters:
        - key: correspondent
          operator: is_empty
          value: ""
      source: invoices/
    - id: nested
      name: Nested
      filter_group:
        operator: all
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gte
              value: "5.5"
        groups:
            - operator: any
              filters:
                - key: status
                  value: paid
                - key: status
                  value: open
      source: invoices/

vault.bases/open.md:
---
type: base
title: Open
created: "$TIME"
tags:
    - base
base_id: open
views:
    - id: open
      name: Open
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: open
      columns:
        - title
        - amount
      source: invoices/
    - id: paid
      name: Paid
      filters:
        - key: status
          value: paid
      filter_group:
        operator: and
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gt
              value: "5"
      source: invoices/
    - id: comp
      name: Computed
      computed:
        label:
            formula: '{title} costs {amount}'
        links:
            rollup: count
      columns:
        - title
        - label
        - links
      source: invoices/
    - id: roll
      name: Rollups
      computed:
        l:
            rollup: list(links.title)
        "n":
            rollup: count
        s:
            rollup: sum(links.amount)
        x:
            rollup: other
      source: invoices/
    - id: none
      name: No match
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: nothing
      source: invoices/
    - id: ops
      name: Ops
      filters:
        - key: title
          operator: contains
          value: O
      filter_group:
        operator: any
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: lt
              value: "6"
            - key: status
              operator: in
              value: paid, closed
      source: invoices/
    - id: dates
      name: Dates
      filters:
        - key: due_date
          operator: on_or_after
          value: "2026-02-01"
      source: invoices/
    - id: noteq
      name: Not equal
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: not_equals
          value: OPEN
      source: invoices/
    - id: empty
      name: Empty op
      filters:
        - key: correspondent
          operator: is_empty
          value: ""
      source: invoices/
    - id: nested
      name: Nested
      filter_group:
        operator: all
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gte
              value: "5.5"
        groups:
            - operator: any
              filters:
                - key: status
                  value: paid
                - key: status
                  value: open
      source: invoices/

type: base
title: Open
created: "$TIME"

    - base

    - id: open
      name: Open
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: open
      columns:
        - title

      source: invoices/
    - id: paid
      name: Paid
      filters:
        - key: status
          value: paid
      filter_group:
        operator: and
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gt
              value: "5"
      source: invoices/
    - id: comp
      name: Computed
      computed:
        label:
            formula: '{title} costs {amount}'
        links:
            rollup: count
      columns:
        - title
        - label
        - links
      source: invoices/
    - id: roll
      name: Rollups
      computed:
        l:
            rollup: list(links.title)
        "n":
            rollup: count
        s:
            rollup: sum(links.amount)
        x:
            rollup: other
      source: invoices/
    - id: none
      name: No match
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: nothing
      source: invoices/
    - id: ops
      name: Ops
      filters:
        - key: title
          operator: contains
          value: O
      filter_group:
        operator: any
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: lt
              value: "6"
            - key: status
              operator: in
              value: paid, closed
      source: invoices/
    - id: dates
      name: Dates
      filters:
        - key: due_date
          operator: on_or_after
          value: "2026-02-01"
      source: invoices/
    - id: noteq
      name: Not equal
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: not_equals
          value: OPEN
      source: invoices/
    - id: empty
      name: Empty op
      filters:
        - key: correspondent
          operator: is_empty
          value: ""
      source: invoices/
    - id: nested
      name: Nested
      filter_group:
        operator: all
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gte
              value: "5.5"
        groups:
            - operator: any

vault.bases/open.md:
---
type: base
title: Open
created: "$TIME"
tags:
    - base
base_id: open
views:
    - id: open
      name: Open
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: open
      columns:
        - title
        - amount
      source: invoices/
    - id: paid
      name: Paid
      filters:
        - key: status
          value: paid
      filter_group:
        operator: and
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gt
              value: "5"
      source: invoices/
    - id: comp
      name: Computed
      computed:
        label:
            formula: '{title} costs {amount}'
        links:
            rollup: count
      columns:
        - title
        - label
        - links
      source: invoices/
    - id: roll
      name: Rollups
      computed:
        l:
            rollup: list(links.title)
        "n":
            rollup: count
        s:
            rollup: sum(links.amount)
        x:
            rollup: other
      source: invoices/
    - id: none
      name: No match
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: nothing
      source: invoices/
    - id: ops
      name: Ops
      filters:
        - key: title
          operator: contains
          value: O
      filter_group:
        operator: any
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: lt
              value: "6"
            - key: status
              operator: in
              value: paid, closed
      source: invoices/
    - id: dates
      name: Dates
      filters:
        - key: due_date
          operator: on_or_after
          value: "2026-02-01"
      source: invoices/
    - id: noteq
      name: Not equal
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: not_equals
          value: OPEN
      source: invoices/
    - id: empty
      name: Empty op
      filters:
        - key: correspondent
          operator: is_empty
          value: ""
      source: invoices/
    - id: nested
      name: Nested
      filter_group:
        operator: all
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gte
              value: "5.5"
        groups:
            - operator: any
              filters:
                - key: status
                  value: paid
                - key: status
                  value: open
      source: invoices/
---

vault.bases/open.md:
---
type: base
title: Open
created: "$TIME"
tags:
    - base
base_id: open
views:
    - id: open
      name: Open
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: open
      columns:
        - title
        - amount
      source: invoices/
    - id: paid
      name: Paid
      filters:
        - key: status
          value: paid
      filter_group:
        operator: and
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gt
              value: "5"
      source: invoices/
    - id: comp
      name: Computed
      computed:
        label:
            formula: '{title} costs {amount}'
        links:
            rollup: count
      columns:
        - title
        - label
        - links
      source: invoices/
    - id: roll
      name: Rollups
      computed:
        l:
            rollup: list(links.title)
        "n":
            rollup: count
        s:
            rollup: sum(links.amount)
        x:
            rollup: other
      source: invoices/
    - id: none
      name: No match
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: nothing
      source: invoices/
    - id: ops
      name: Ops
      filters:
        - key: title
          operator: contains
          value: O
      filter_group:
        operator: any
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: lt
              value: "6"
            - key: status
              operator: in
              value: paid, closed
      source: invoices/
    - id: dates
      name: Dates
      filters:
        - key: due_date
          operator: on_or_after
          value: "2026-02-01"
      source: invoices/
    - id: noteq
      name: Not equal
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: not_equals
          value: OPEN
      source: invoices/
    - id: empty
      name: Empty op
      filters:
        - key: correspondent
          operator: is_empty
          value: ""
      source: invoices/
    - id: nested
      name: Nested
      filter_group:
        operator: all
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gte
              value: "5.5"
        groups:
            - operator: any
              filters:
                - key: status
                  value: paid
                - key: status
                  value: open
      source: invoices/

vault.bases/open.md:
---
type: base
title: Open
created: "$TIME"
tags:
    - base
base_id: open
views:
    - id: open
      name: Open
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: open
      columns:
        - title
        - amount
      source: invoices/
    - id: paid
      name: Paid
      filters:
        - key: status
          value: paid
      filter_group:
        operator: and
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gt
              value: "5"
      source: invoices/
    - id: comp
      name: Computed
      computed:
        label:
            formula: '{title} costs {amount}'
        links:
            rollup: count
      columns:
        - title
        - label
        - links
      source: invoices/
    - id: roll
      name: Rollups
      computed:
        l:
            rollup: list(links.title)
        "n":
            rollup: count
        s:
            rollup: sum(links.amount)
        x:
            rollup: other
      source: invoices/
    - id: none
      name: No match
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: nothing
      source: invoices/
    - id: ops
      name: Ops
      filters:
        - key: title
          operator: contains
          value: O
      filter_group:
        operator: any
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: lt
              value: "6"
            - key: status
              operator: in
              value: paid, closed
      source: invoices/
    - id: dates
      name: Dates
      filters:
        - key: due_date
          operator: on_or_after
          value: "2026-02-01"
      source: invoices/
    - id: noteq
      name: Not equal
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: not_equals
          value: OPEN
      source: invoices/
    - id: empty
      name: Empty op
      filters:
        - key: correspondent
          operator: is_empty
          value: ""
      source: invoices/
    - id: nested
      name: Nested
      filter_group:
        operator: all
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gte
              value: "5.5"
        groups:
            - operator: any
              filters:
                - key: status
                  value: paid
                - key: status
                  value: open
      source: invoices/
---

vault.bases/open.md:
---
type: base
title: Open
created: "$TIME"
tags:
    - base
base_id: open
views:
    - id: open
      name: Open
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: open
      columns:
        - title
        - amount
      source: invoices/
    - id: paid
      name: Paid
      filters:
        - key: status
          value: paid
      filter_group:
        operator: and
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gt
              value: "5"
      source: invoices/
    - id: comp
      name: Computed
      computed:
        label:
            formula: '{title} costs {amount}'
        links:
            rollup: count
      columns:
        - title
        - label
        - links
      source: invoices/
    - id: roll
      name: Rollups
      computed:
        l:
            rollup: list(links.title)
        "n":
            rollup: count
        s:
            rollup: sum(links.amount)
        x:
            rollup: other
      source: invoices/
    - id: none
      name: No match
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: nothing
      source: invoices/
    - id: ops
      name: Ops
      filters:
        - key: title
          operator: contains
          value: O
      filter_group:
        operator: any
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: lt
              value: "6"
            - key: status
              operator: in
              value: paid, closed
      source: invoices/
    - id: dates
      name: Dates
      filters:
        - key: due_date
          operator: on_or_after
          value: "2026-02-01"
      source: invoices/
    - id: noteq
      name: Not equal
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: not_equals
          value: OPEN
      source: invoices/
    - id: empty
      name: Empty op
      filters:
        - key: correspondent
          operator: is_empty
          value: ""
      source: invoices/
    - id: nested
      name: Nested
      filter_group:
        operator: all
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gte
              value: "5.5"
        groups:
            - operator: any
              filters:
                - key: status
                  value: paid
                - key: status
                  value: open
      source: invoices/

vault.bases/open.md:
---
type: base
title: Open
created: "$TIME"
tags:
    - base
base_id: open
views:
    - id: open
      name: Open
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: open
      columns:
        - title
        - amount
      source: invoices/
    - id: paid
      name: Paid
      filters:
        - key: status
          value: paid
      filter_group:
        operator: and
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gt
              value: "5"
      source: invoices/
    - id: comp
      name: Computed
      computed:
        label:
            formula: '{title} costs {amount}'
        links:
            rollup: count
      columns:
        - title
        - label
        - links
      source: invoices/
    - id: roll
      name: Rollups
      computed:
        l:
            rollup: list(links.title)
        "n":
            rollup: count
        s:
            rollup: sum(links.amount)
        x:
            rollup: other
      source: invoices/
    - id: none
      name: No match
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: nothing
      source: invoices/
    - id: ops
      name: Ops
      filters:
        - key: title
          operator: contains
          value: O
      filter_group:
        operator: any
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: lt
              value: "6"
            - key: status
              operator: in
              value: paid, closed
      source: invoices/
    - id: dates
      name: Dates
      filters:
        - key: due_date
          operator: on_or_after
          value: "2026-02-01"
      source: invoices/
    - id: noteq
      name: Not equal
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: not_equals
          value: OPEN
      source: invoices/
    - id: empty
      name: Empty op
      filters:
        - key: correspondent
          operator: is_empty
          value: ""
      source: invoices/
    - id: nested
      name: Nested
      filter_group:
        operator: all
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gte
              value: "5.5"
        groups:
            - operator: any
              filters:
                - key: status
                  value: paid
                - key: status
                  value: open
      source: invoices/
---

type: base
title: Open
created: "$TIME"
tags:
    - base
base_id: open
views:
    - id: open
      name: Open
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: open
      columns:
        - title
        - amount
      source: invoices/
    - id: paid
      name: Paid
      filters:
        - key: status
          value: paid
      filter_group:
        operator: and
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gt
              value: "5"
      source: invoices/
    - id: comp
      name: Computed
      computed:
        label:
            formula: '{title} costs {amount}'
        links:
            rollup: count
      columns:
        - title
        - label
        - links
      source: invoices/
    - id: roll
      name: Rollups
      computed:
        l:
            rollup: list(links.title)
        "n":
            rollup: count
        s:
            rollup: sum(links.amount)
        x:
            rollup: other
      source: invoices/
    - id: none
      name: No match
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: nothing
      source: invoices/
    - id: ops
      name: Ops
      filters:
        - key: title
          operator: contains
          value: O
      filter_group:
        operator: any
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: lt
              value: "6"
            - key: status
              operator: in
              value: paid, closed
      source: invoices/
    - id: dates
      name: Dates
      filters:
        - key: due_date
          operator: on_or_after
          value: "2026-02-01"
      source: invoices/
    - id: noteq
      name: Not equal
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: not_equals
          value: OPEN
      source: invoices/
    - id: empty
      name: Empty op
      filters:
        - key: correspondent
          operator: is_empty
          value: ""
      source: invoices/
    - id: nested
      name: Nested
      filter_group:
        operator: all
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gte
              value: "5.5"
        groups:
            - operator: any
              filters:

      source: invoices/

vault.bases/open.md:
---
type: base
title: Open
created: "$TIME"
tags:
    - base
base_id: open
views:
    - id: open
      name: Open
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: open
      columns:
        - title
        - amount
      source: invoices/
    - id: paid
      name: Paid
      filters:
        - key: status
          value: paid
      filter_group:
        operator: and
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gt
              value: "5"
      source: invoices/
    - id: comp
      name: Computed
      computed:
        label:
            formula: '{title} costs {amount}'
        links:
            rollup: count
      columns:
        - title
        - label
        - links
      source: invoices/
    - id: roll
      name: Rollups
      computed:
        l:
            rollup: list(links.title)
        "n":
            rollup: count
        s:
            rollup: sum(links.amount)
        x:
            rollup: other
      source: invoices/
    - id: none
      name: No match
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: nothing
      source: invoices/
    - id: ops
      name: Ops
      filters:
        - key: title
          operator: contains
          value: O
      filter_group:
        operator: any
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: lt
              value: "6"
            - key: status
              operator: in
              value: paid, closed
      source: invoices/
    - id: dates
      name: Dates
      filters:
        - key: due_date
          operator: on_or_after
          value: "2026-02-01"
      source: invoices/
    - id: noteq
      name: Not equal
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: not_equals
          value: OPEN
      source: invoices/
    - id: empty
      name: Empty op
      filters:
        - key: correspondent
          operator: is_empty
          value: ""
      source: invoices/
    - id: nested
      name: Nested
      filter_group:
        operator: all
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gte
              value: "5.5"
        groups:
            - operator: any
              filters:
                - key: status
                  value: paid
                - key: status
                  value: open
      source: invoices/
---

vault.bases/open.md:
---
type: base
title: Open
created: "$TIME"
tags:
    - base
base_id: open
views:
    - id: open
      name: Open
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: open
      columns:
        - title
        - amount
      source: invoices/
    - id: paid
      name: Paid
      filters:
        - key: status
          value: paid
      filter_group:
        operator: and
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gt
              value: "5"
      source: invoices/
    - id: comp
      name: Computed
      computed:
        label:
            formula: '{title} costs {amount}'
        links:
            rollup: count
      columns:
        - title
        - label
        - links
      source: invoices/
    - id: roll
      name: Rollups
      computed:
        l:
            rollup: list(links.title)
        "n":
            rollup: count
        s:
            rollup: sum(links.amount)
        x:
            rollup: other
      source: invoices/
    - id: none
      name: No match
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: nothing
      source: invoices/
    - id: ops
      name: Ops
      filters:
        - key: title
          operator: contains
          value: O
      filter_group:
        operator: any
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: lt
              value: "6"
            - key: status
              operator: in
              value: paid, closed
      source: invoices/
    - id: dates
      name: Dates
      filters:
        - key: due_date
          operator: on_or_after
          value: "2026-02-01"
      source: invoices/
    - id: noteq
      name: Not equal
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: not_equals
          value: OPEN
      source: invoices/
    - id: empty
      name: Empty op
      filters:
        - key: correspondent
          operator: is_empty
          value: ""
      source: invoices/
    - id: nested
      name: Nested
      filter_group:
        operator: all
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gte
              value: "5.5"
        groups:
            - operator: any
              filters:
                - key: status
                  value: paid
                - key: status
                  value: open
      source: invoices/
---

type: base
title: Open
created: "$TIME"

    - base

views:
    - id: open
      name: Open
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: open
      columns:
        - title
        - amount
      source: invoices/
    - id: paid
      name: Paid
      filters:
        - key: status
          value: paid
      filter_group:
        operator: and
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gt
              value: "5"
      source: invoices/
    - id: comp
      name: Computed
      computed:
        label:
            formula: '{title} costs {amount}'
        links:
            rollup: count
      columns:
        - title
        - label
        - links
      source: invoices/
    - id: roll
      name: Rollups
      computed:
        l:
            rollup: list(links.title)
        "n":
            rollup: count
        s:
            rollup: sum(links.amount)
        x:
            rollup: other
      source: invoices/
    - id: none
      name: No match
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: equals
          value: nothing
      source: invoices/
    - id: ops
      name: Ops
      filters:
        - key: title
          operator: contains
          value: O
      filter_group:
        operator: any
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: lt
              value: "6"
            - key: status
              operator: in
              value: paid, closed
      source: invoices/
    - id: dates
      name: Dates
      filters:
        - key: due_date
          operator: on_or_after
          value: "2026-02-01"
      source: invoices/
    - id: noteq
      name: Not equal
      filters:
        - key: status
          operator: not_equals
          value: OPEN
      source: invoices/
    - id: empty
      name: Empty op
      filters:
        - key: correspondent
          operator: is_empty
          value: ""
      source: invoices/
    - id: nested
      name: Nested
      filter_group:
        operator: all
        filters:
            - key: amount
              operator: gte
              value: "5.5"
        groups:
            - operator: any
              filters:
                - key: status
                  value: paid
                - key: status
                  value: open
      source: invoices/
